info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Agents-v3-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings by Agent API facilitates the retrieval of property listings associated with specific real estate agents. This endpoint serves as a valuable resource for real estate platforms looking to display available properties managed by agents to potential buyers. Developers can use this API to enhance user experiences by presenting comprehensive property data tailored to the agent's portfolio. Typical consumers include real estate applications, market analysis tools, and consumer-facing websites seeking to showcase agent-specific property offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve listings associated with a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all property listings that are associated with a given real estate agent. It's useful for agents to view and share their current properties.
